faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NII Research Associate-I/SRF (Project) posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 22nd August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: For RA-I, a PhD in Biological Science with molecular genetics training is required. For SRF, an M.Sc./M.Tech. in Life Sciences with 2 years of research experience in molecular genetics and a cleared national-level test like NET/GATE is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this NII recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Research Associate-I/SRF (Project) positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and invited for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I and SRF posts?
faq.answer: For Research Associate-I, the salary is Rs. 58,000/- per month plus 30% HRA. For SRF, it is Rs. 42,000/- per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Immunology (NII).

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these NII jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is via Email. Candidates need to send their applications electronically.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-I/SRF (Project) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-I/SRF (Project) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the walk-in interview date for the NII recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates will be conducted online on 27th August 2026.
